[[File:Adamant sword detail.png|left|100px]]
The '''adamant sword''' is the second-strongest [[sword]] available to [[free player]]s, after the [[rune sword]]. As with most [[adamant weapons]], level 30 [[Attack]] is required to wield it.

Adamant swords can be created at level 74 [[Smithing]]. One [[adamant bar]] is required to make the sword, and 62.5 Smithing experience is rewarded per sword created.
